summary: Validated the new 'Vendo' (privato publishes used product) module end-to-end plus admin seller-phone fields and regression on existing annunci flows. Backend: 4/4 pytest PASS (meta, privato CRUD + photo-url + ownership 403 + delete, azienda endpoint forbids privato, admin can create/update annuncio with azienda_nome/azienda_telefono). Frontend: full E2E PASS on area-privato -> tab Vendo -> dialog validation (empty title + short telefono blocked by toast) -> publish -> foto da URL (picsum) -> edit prezzo -> detail page shows 'Chiama' button + 'Annuncio pubblicato da un privato' note + 'Privato' badge next to seller name -> marketplace card (/mercatino) renders annuncio-call-{id} tel: button -> delete removes card. One minor UX gap: in list/card view (AnnuncioCard) the 'Privato' etichetta is NOT shown next to a.azienda_nome (line 51); only the detail page's ContattoAzienda shows it. User requirement said 'con il nome del venditore e l'etichetta Privato' also on the marketplace card.

ui_bugs.issue: On marketplace card the 'Privato' etichetta/badge is not rendered next to seller name for annunci with venditore_privato=true. Only ContattoAzienda (detail page) renders it. Add a small 'Privato' chip near a.azienda_nome in AnnuncioCard when a.venditore_privato || !a.azienda_id.

issues: Radix warning in console: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility, non-blocking).

action_items: (Optional, minor UX) In /app/frontend/src/components/AnnuncioCard.jsx around line 51, when a.venditore_privato || !a.azienda_id, render a 'Privato' chip next to a.azienda_nome (same style used in ContattoAzienda) instead of VerifiedBadge. This matches the explicit requirement 'con il nome del venditore e l'etichetta Privato' on the Mercatino cards.
(Nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Vendi dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_annunci.py: POST /annunci/privato correctly hardcodes tipo='usato' and unita='fisso' and uses require_roles('privato') — good. azienda_telefono is reused for the private phone number (schema-wise OK but semantically 'azienda_' prefix is misleading now that privati also use it; consider renaming to 'contatto_telefono' for v2).
routes_annunci.py _owned uses doc['owner_id'] == user['id'] — correct 403 enforcement for both roles. PUT accepts 'telefono' and maps to azienda_telefono — matches the frontend payload.

foto-url endpoint deduplicates URLs with urlparse scheme check and respects MAX_FOTO_ANNUNCIO (10). Good. However errori list includes 'download non riuscito' with 20s timeout per URL — if a user pastes 50 bad URLs the request can take up to 50*20=1000s. Consider capping total elapsed time or using asyncio.gather with a shorter per-URL timeout.
AnnuncioCard.jsx line 51 renders VerifiedBadge even for privati (always false). Replace with a conditional Privato chip when venditore_privato is true (small UX miss).

VenditePrivato.jsx submit() swallows the 'immagine_url' field on edit (payload sent to PUT does not include it). If the user set an URL on create but then edits, they cannot change immagine_url via the UI anymore. Minor.
VenditePrivato.jsx uses prezzo as 'number' but Input type='number' with min='1' — browser accepts decimals which is fine for prezzo. OK.
